_comment: Krea 2 Turbo, Krea's 12B open-weights text-to-image model, distilled to 8 steps. LICENCE, read before shipping anything it makes: the Krea 2 Community License Agreement v.1 (2026-06-22) allows commercial use of the model and of its Outputs 'only if you (including all affiliated entities under common ownership or control) have total company-wide annual revenue of less than one million United States dollars', and past that 'you must immediately cease Commercial Use and contact Krea'. Krea may end it 'for any reason upon thirty (30) days' prior written or electronic notice', and section 4.2 requires 'reasonable and appropriate Content Filter measures'. See docs/guide/licensing.md. The settings are Comfy-Org's template image_krea2_turbo_t2i_int8 (workflow_templates commit 3e50a92, read 2026-10-10): the int8 ConvRot weights, the Qwen3-VL 4B encoder on CLIPLoader type krea2, the same qwen_image_vae as the Qwen graphs, 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple, and an empty negative from ConditioningZeroOut. cfg 1 means no classifier-free guidance, so everything goes in the prompt. The template's prompt enhancer, a TextGenerate on the same encoder, is left out. 864x1152 is 3:4, so a figure stays head to toe and img2video_wan22's 480x640 keeps its shape, at the pixel count of the template's 1024x1024. Run on the reference 16 GB card on 2026-10-10, in image 0.1.11: 864x1152 took 22.3 s on ComfyUI's clock (8 steps at 2.43 s each) with VRAM peaking at 15,786 MiB of 16,066 (nvidia-smi every 0.5 s); 1024x1024 took 27.9 s, peak 15,678 MiB. The int8 weights load whole onto the card (12,867 MB in the server log), which leaves little for activations: 1104x1472, the Qwen concept size, and a batch of two at 864x1152 both ran out of GPU memory. Make takes one at a time. Needs the krea2 weight group: scripts/fetch_models.py --download --group krea2.

inputs.text: A weathered stone golem overgrown with moss, a single creature standing upright, the whole figure visible from head to feet in a three-quarter view. Even flat studio lighting, a plain neutral grey background and no cast shadow. Painted game asset concept art with a crisp, readable silhouette and sharp detail.
